title: 大阪杯の後に・リスタート

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Right when I was worried about whether I'd run the best I could, something bonkers happened! I saw that everyone from back home had come to cheer me on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Seeing all their faces gave me a real boost! It's like Granny used to say, "Life's a marathon, not a sprint!" Looks like I was a little in my head before.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: My next goal's to dazzle at the Victoria Mile! By then, I'm sure my running will be even spiffier than it is now!
